source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 37.1 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Alcanadre (stage 9) on 2026-10-25, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-10-24. 7 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Alcanadre (stage 9) 37, Logroño (stage 8) 34, Navarrete (stage 7) 34, Bujaraloz (stage 18) 31, Candasnos (stage 19) 31, Fraga (stage 20) 28. FWI anomaly at Alcanadre is +7.6 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
